name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. She spent the first part of her career in manufacturing, streamlining processes and improving efficiency in a factory setting. After taking early retirement, she volunteered at a local racing team and quickly found her knack for the organizational and logistical challenges of motorsport. 

As Head of Operations, Aisyah focuses on creating a highly efficient and reliable structure. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute. While new to the top level, her calm demeanor and meticulous approach make her a valuable asset, and she's eager to prove her abilities at the highest levels of racing. Her visionary nature helps her foresee potential problems and implement preventative measures to keep the team running smoothly.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low bun
physical.description: Aisyah has a kind face framed by fine lines from years of smiling.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk.
Starts every morning with a cup of teh tarik.
